title: Crazy Kutumba
desc: When Gowri gets selected for a dance competition, she travels to Bangalore with her dysfunctional family. During this journey, they get to know each other and iron out their differences.

title: Kurubana Rani
desc: Kencha and Rani mutually agree to take part in a staged wedding ceremony. However, things take an unexpected turn after Kencha falls in love with Rani.

title: F3: Fun and Frustration
desc: Venky and Varun brainstorm various strategies to overcome their economic challenges. However, complications arise when they cross paths with a businessman.

title: Martin
desc: In a twist of fate, a man trying to defend his motherland encounters his doppelgänger, who turns out to be his deadliest foe to date.

title: Veeran
desc: Kumaran, a teenage boy, gets struck by lightning and goes into a coma. He wakes up realising that he has superhuman abilities post the accident.

title: Raju Kannada Medium
desc: Raju, a village boy, travels to Bengaluru in search of a better job. Along the way, he faces numerous challenges that teach him valuable life lessons.
